item.title: Texas DPS to increase traffic enforcement during spring break, St. Patrick’s Day
item.description: The Texas Department of Public Safety said it would increase patrols during spring break and St. Patrick’s Day.

item.title: Videos show US citizen's shooting death in Texas last year by federal immigration agent
item.description: Newly released videos showing the fatal shooting of a U.S. citizen by a federal immigration agent in Texas last year call into question assertions by the Department of Homeland Security that a driver intentionally rammed an agent with his car.

item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: Oil prices surpassed $90 a barrel Friday, with American crude settling at $90.90, up 36% from a week ago.

item.title: Here's what's going on at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo on Saturday, March 7
item.description: While there is some severe weather in the forecast, there still should be plenty to do at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo on Saturday.

item.title: Man accused of setting fires outside West Oaks Mall charged with arson
item.description: A man is behind bars charged with multiple counts of arson after he allegedly try to burn trash outside of a west Houston mall.

item.title: Heavy rain expected across Texas; rivers could rise, officials warn
item.description: Texans warned to prepare for rising rivers as rain and thunderstorms move across the state. Emergency officials monitor for flooding.

item.title: Plane from Houston that crashed in Maine spent more time on runway than recommended after deicing, NTSB says
item.description: A preliminary report shows that a Houston private jet that crashed in Maine in January remained on the ground 8 minutes longer than it should have after receiving a deicing treatment during a snowstorm.

item.title: Daylight Saving Time begins this weekend
item.description: We are springing forward this weekend and turning our clocks back an hour which means you will lose an hour of sleep but gain more daylight overall.

item.title: Constable searching for burglary suspect in Montrose area
item.description: The search continues for the man caught on camera breaking into homes in Montrose.

item.title: Severe storms could produce large hail, damaging winds in Southeast Texas Saturday
item.description: Southeast Texas is under a Slight Risk of severe storms on Saturday, with the potential for large hail, damaging winds, and heavy rainfall, and street flooding is a concern.
